og0001: A shortened sit-up that stops at about 45 degrees, keeping tension on the abs the whole time.

En gardant la poitrine relevée et la sangle abdominale gainée, abaisse ton corps en position de squat en fléchissant les genoux et les hanches.
Continue à descendre jusqu'à ce que tes cuisses soient parallèles au sol, ou aussi bas que tu peux confortablement aller.
Marque une pause en bas, puis pousse sur tes talons pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0535: You swing a kettlebell from a hang position up to the rack at your shoulder in one smooth pull. Trains the hips, back and shoulders for power.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell devant tes cuisses.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule vers l'avant au niveau des hanches en gardant le dos droit.
Abaisse le kettlebell vers le sol, en le laissant se balancer entre tes jambes.
Étends rapidement tes hanches et tes genoux, en utilisant l'élan pour faire monter le kettlebell à hauteur des épaules.
Lorsque le kettlebell atteint la hauteur des épaules, fais pivoter tes poignets et réceptionne le kettlebell en position rack, le coude rentré et le kettlebell reposant sur ton avant-bras.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ entre tes jambes, et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0536: A lunge where you pass the kettlebell around your front leg at the bottom. Works the legs and glutes while challenging your balance and core.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell devant ta poitrine à deux mains.
Fais un pas en avant avec le pied droit, en abaissant ton corps en position de fente.
En te fendant vers l'avant, fais passer le kettlebell sous ta cuisse droite et transfère-le dans ta main gauche.
Pousse sur ton pied droit pour revenir à la position de départ, tout en repassant simultanément le kettlebell dans ta main droite.
Répète la fente du côté opposé, en passant le kettlebell sous ta cuisse gauche.
Continue à alterner les fentes et à passer la kettlebell d'une main à l'autre pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0537: You clean a kettlebell to your shoulder, then dip and drive it overhead with one arm. A full body power move for legs, shoulders and core.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main en prise pronation.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule au niveau des hanches en abaissant la kettlebell entre tes jambes.
Étends de manière explosive tes hanches, tes genoux et tes chevilles, en utilisant l'élan pour balancer la kettlebell jusqu'à hauteur des épaules.
Lorsque le kettlebell atteint la hauteur des épaules, fais pivoter ton poignet et propulse ta main bien droit vers le haut en verrouillant ton bras au-dessus de la tête.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0538: Dip and drive with your legs to throw a kettlebell from the shoulder to overhead with one arm. Builds explosive shoulder and leg power.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main à hauteur d'épaule.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et gaine ta sangle abdominale.
Développe le kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête en ligne droite, en tendant complètement ton bras.
En poussant le kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête, fléchis simultanément tes genoux et redresse-les rapidement pour générer de l'élan.
Lorsque le kettlebell atteint son point le plus haut, glisse-toi rapidement en dessous en fléchissant tes genoux et tes hanches.
Réceptionne la kettlebell avec une légère flexion des genoux et des hanches, et ton bras complètement tendu au-dessus de ta tête.
Tiens-toi bien droit, en étendant complètement les genoux et les hanches, et stabilise le kettlebell au-dessus de la tête.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ en fléchissant tes genoux et tes hanches, et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0539: A standing one arm kettlebell press where the path drifts out to the side. Works the shoulder and upper back while your core resists leaning.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main à hauteur d'épaule.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et garde ton dos droit.
Développe le kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête, en tendant complètement ton bras.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement le kettlebell pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de côté.
og0540: Use a small leg dip and drive to push one kettlebell overhead. It lets you move more weight than a strict press and trains shoulders, triceps and legs.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main à hauteur d'épaule.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et gaine ta sangle abdominale.
Développe le kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête en tendant ton bras et en tendant complètement tes jambes.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ en fléchissant tes genoux et en ramenant le kettlebell à ton épaule.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de côté.
og0541: Hinge forward and row a kettlebell to your hip with one arm. Targets the lats and upper back while your core keeps you steady.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main en prise pronation.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule vers l'avant au niveau des hanches en gardant le dos droit et ta sangle abdominale gainée.
Tire le kettlebell vers le haut en direction de ta poitrine en gardant ton coude près de ton corps et en contractant tes omoplates l'une vers l'autre.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement le kettlebell pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de côté et recommence avec l'autre bras.
og0542: You swing a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one fluid motion with a single arm. A power exercise for hips, shoulders and back.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main entre tes jambes.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule au niveau des hanches en abaissant la kettlebell vers le sol.
Étends de manière explosive tes hanches et tes genoux, en utilisant l'élan pour balancer la kettlebell vers ton épaule.
Lorsque le kettlebell atteint la hauteur des épaules, fais pivoter ta main et propulse-le bien droit au-dessus de la tête en étendant complètement ton bras.
Abaisse le kettlebell entre tes jambes et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0543: A kettlebell hinge and carry style move that works the hips and lower back while you keep a flat back and steady core.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell d'une main.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule vers l'avant au niveau des hanches en gardant le dos droit.
Lève le kettlebell à hauteur des épaules en gardant ton coude près de ton corps.
Étends complètement ton bras au-dessus de la tête, en redressant ton coude.
Abaisse le kettlebell à hauteur des épaules, puis reviens à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de côté.
og0544: A single leg squat holding a kettlebell at your chest as a counterweight. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell devant ta poitrine à deux mains.
Décolle ton pied gauche du sol et étends-le vers l'avant, en le gardant parallèle au sol.
Abaisse lentement ton corps en position accroupie, en gardant ton pied droit à plat sur le sol et ta jambe gauche tendue.
Marque une pause en bas du squat, puis pousse sur ton talon droit pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de jambe.
og0545: An explosive push-up with your hands on kettlebells. You push hard enough to lift off, which trains chest and arm power.
Commence en position de planche haute, les mains sur les kettlebells, écartées à la largeur des épaules.
Abaisse ta poitrine vers le sol, en gardant les coudes près de ton corps.
Pousse à travers tes mains de manière explosive en soulevant tes mains des kettlebells et en tendant complètement tes bras.
Atterris en douceur sur les kettlebells et rabaisse immédiatement ta poitrine pour la répétition suivante.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0546: Seated on a bench, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead. Takes the legs out so your shoulders and triceps do the work.
Assieds-toi sur un banc, le dos droit et les pieds à plat sur le sol.
Tiens un kettlebell dans chaque main à hauteur des épaules, les paumes tournées vers l'avant.
Développe les kettlebells au-dessus de ta tête, en tendant complètement tes bras.
Abaisse les kettlebells à hauteur des épaules.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0547: You press one kettlebell up while the other lowers, like a seesaw. Works the shoulders and triceps with a steady rhythm.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell dans chaque main à hauteur d'épaule.
Développe un kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête tout en gardant l'autre kettlebell à hauteur des épaules.
Abaisse le kettlebell pressé à hauteur des épaules tout en pressant simultanément l'autre kettlebell au-dessus de la tête.
Continue à alterner le mouvement de poussée en créant un mouvement de bascule.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0548: A wide stance pull where you drive through your legs and row a kettlebell up to chest height. Hits the traps, shoulders and hips.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds plus écartés que la largeur des épaules, les orteils tournés vers l'extérieur.
Tiens un kettlebell des deux mains devant ton corps, les bras étendus vers le bas.
Fléchis les genoux et abaisse tes hanches en position accroupie en gardant le dos droit.
Pousse sur tes talons et étends explosivement tes hanches et tes genoux, en tirant le kettlebell vers ton menton.
En tirant le kettlebell vers le haut, garde tes coudes hauts et écartés et contracte tes omoplates l'une vers l'autre.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0549: A hip hinge move where you swing a kettlebell to chest height using your hips. Great for glutes, hamstrings and posterior chain power.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, les orteils légèrement tournés vers l'extérieur.
Tiens le kettlebell des deux mains devant ton corps, les bras étendus.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule au niveau des hanches en poussant tes fesses vers l'arrière.
Balance le kettlebell vers l'arrière entre tes jambes, en gardant les bras tendus et le dos plat.
Pousse tes hanches vers l'avant et balance le kettlebell jusqu'à hauteur d'épaule, en utilisant l'élan généré par tes hanches.
Laisse le kettlebell revenir en balancier entre tes jambes et répète le mouvement pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0550: You squat with a kettlebell at your chest, then stand and press it overhead in one motion. A full body move for legs and shoulders.
Commence debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell devant ta poitrine à deux mains, les paumes tournées l'une vers l'autre.
Descends en position de squat en fléchissant tes genoux et en poussant tes hanches vers l'arrière, en gardant ta poitrine relevée et ton dos droit.
Une fois au bas du squat, pousse explosivement sur tes talons pour te relever tout en poussant simultanément le kettlebell au-dessus de ta tête.
Verrouille tes bras en haut du mouvement, en étendant complètement tes coudes.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ en inversant le mouvement, en fléchissant tes coudes et en ramenant le poids à ta poitrine.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0551: A Turkish get up where you come up through a squat style transition while keeping the kettlebell overhead. Trains full body control, stability and strength.
Commence allongé sur le dos, les jambes tendues et le kettlebell tenu dans ta main droite, le bras complètement tendu au-dessus de ton épaule.
Fléchis ton genou droit et pose ton pied droit à plat sur le sol en gardant ta jambe gauche tendue.
En poussant sur ton pied droit, soulève tes hanches du sol, en venant dans une position de pont.
Fais glisser ta jambe gauche sous ton corps, en fléchissant le genou gauche et en posant le pied gauche à plat sur le sol.
Fais pivoter ton torse vers la gauche, en amenant ta main gauche au sol pour te soutenir.
En poussant sur ton pied droit et ta main gauche, soulève ton torse du sol, en venant dans une position agenouillée.
Depuis la position à genoux, lève-toi en gardant le kettlebell tendu au-dessus de la tête.
Inverse le mouvement pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète l'exercice de l'autre côté, en commençant avec le kettlebell dans ta main gauche.
og0552: You pull a kettlebell from between your thighs up to the rack position with both hands. Trains hip power, back and shoulders.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell devant tes cuisses à deux mains, paumes tournées vers toi.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et bascule au niveau des hanches en abaissant la kettlebell vers le sol.
Étends de manière explosive tes hanches et tes genoux, en utilisant l'élan pour tirer la kettlebell vers tes épaules.

Lorsque le kettlebell atteint la hauteur des épaules, fais pivoter tes poignets et réceptionne le kettlebell en position rack, les coudes rentrés et le kettlebell reposant sur l'arrière de ton avant-bras.
Abaisse le kettlebell jusqu'à la position de départ et répète pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0553: Standing, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead from shoulder height. Builds shoulder and triceps strength with a braced core.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell dans chaque main à hauteur d'épaule, paumes tournées vers l'avant.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et pousse les kettlebells au-dessus de ta tête, en étendant complètement tes bras.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement les kettlebells pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0554: With a kettlebell held overhead, you push your hips out and reach down toward your foot. Builds shoulder stability, flexibility and core strength.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules, en tenant un kettlebell dans ta main droite au-dessus de ta tête.
Fais tourner ton pied gauche vers l'extérieur d'environ 45 degrés et garde ton pied droit pointé vers l'avant.
Penche ton torse vers le côté gauche en gardant ton bras droit tendu au-dessus de ta tête et les yeux sur la kettlebell.
Abaisse ton torse aussi bas que possible en gardant ton bras droit tendu et ton bras gauche étendu sur le côté.
Marque une pause, puis reviens à la position de départ en poussant sur ton pied droit et en gainant tes obliques.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité, puis change de côté.
og0555: A seated core move where you lean back and kick your legs out and in. Works the abs and hip flexors without any equipment.
Assieds-toi au bord d'un banc ou d'une chaise, les pieds à plat sur le sol et les genoux fléchis à un angle de 90 degrés.
Penche-toi légèrement en arrière et place tes mains sur le bord du banc ou de la chaise pour te soutenir.
En gainant tes ischio-jambiers, soulève tes pieds du sol et étends tes jambes droit devant toi.
Marque une pause en haut, puis fléchis lentement tes genoux et ramène tes pieds vers ton corps.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0556: On hands and knees, you press one bent leg up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes with a simple, controlled kickback.
Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and finish all reps, then switch sides.
og0558: A pull-up bar move where you use a swing to get above the bar and then press out. Trains lats, arms and chest, and needs good control.
Commence suspendu à une barre de traction en prise pronation, les mains légèrement plus écartées que la largeur des épaules.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et utilise un mouvement de balancier pour générer de l'élan.
En te balançant vers l'avant, tire ta poitrine vers la barre en utilisant tes grands dorsaux et tes biceps pour initier le mouvement.
Continue le mouvement vers le haut jusqu'à ce que ta poitrine atteigne la barre, puis passe en position de dip en poussant sur la barre et en étendant tes bras.
Redescends jusqu'à la position de départ en pliant les bras et en contrôlant la descente.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0559: Lying on your back, you hug one knee toward your chest. It stretches the glutes and eases the lower back.
Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Bend one knee and clasp your hands around the shin or behind the thigh.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
og0560: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh. Good after sitting or leg training.
Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Place a pad under your back knee if needed.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
og0561: Kneeling on the floor, you press your palms down to stretch the underside of the forearms. Useful for lifters with tight wrists.
Kneel on the floor and place your palms down with fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your palms flat and arms straight.
Slowly sit your hips back to increase the stretch.
Stop when you feel a pull along the inner forearms.
Ease off gently and shake out your hands.
og0562: You hold a landmine barbell at chest height and rotate it in an arc from side to side. Works the obliques and core with strong hip drive.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules et tiens la barre à deux mains devant ta poitrine.
Fléchis légèrement les genoux et fais pivoter ton torse vers la droite en balançant la barre vers ta hanche droite.
Une fois au bas du mouvement, inverse rapidement le mouvement et pivote ton torse vers la gauche en balançant la barre vers le haut et en travers de ton corps vers ton épaule gauche.
Continue ce mouvement de torsion en alternant les côtés, pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0564: A sideways jump onto a box that builds explosive power in the legs. It also trains landing control.
Stand beside a sturdy box or step.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways, landing with both feet on the box.
Land softly with bent knees and stand tall.
Repeat, then switch the side you start from.
og0565: Quick side-to-side steps that build foot speed and agility. It warms up the legs and trains coordination.
Stand in a slight athletic stance with knees bent.
Step quickly to one side, pushing off the opposite foot.
Bring the trailing foot in and step back the other way.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and arms moving naturally.
Work at a fast but controlled pace for the set.
og0567: A box jump with a twist in the air that adds rotation. It builds explosive leg power and trunk control.
Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and rotate your hips to land sideways on the box.
Alternate the twist direction each rep.
og0568: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench. It hits the obliques and builds side-body stability.
Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked and your core tight.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
og0569: Lying on your back with heels on a ball, you curl it toward your hips. It works the hamstrings and core together.
Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and legs straight.
Press your hips up so your body forms a line.
Pull the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Roll the ball back out slowly.
og0570: Seated on a flat bench, you pull your knees in toward your chest and extend them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
Assieds-toi sur un banc plat, les jambes tendues droit devant toi.
Place tes mains sur le banc à côté de tes hanches pour le soutien.
Gaine tes abdominaux et lève tes jambes du sol, en amenant tes genoux vers ta poitrine.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement tes jambes pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0571: Seated on a machine, you pull the handles one arm at a time toward your torso with a narrow grip. Targets the lats and mid back.
Règle la hauteur du siège et la position du repose-pieds pour garantir un bon alignement.
Assieds-toi sur la machine, le dos droit et les pieds à plat sur la plaque de pied.
Saisis les poignées avec une prise serrée, les paumes tournées l'une vers l'autre.
Garde la poitrine relevée et les épaules en arrière tout au long de l'exercice.
Tire une poignée vers ton torse tout en gardant l'autre poignée immobile.
Contracte tes omoplates l'une vers l'autre à la fin du mouvement.
Ramène lentement la poignée à la position de départ et répète de l'autre côté.
Continue à alterner les côtés pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0572: A machine that helps lift your body weight so you can train chin-ups at a lower load. Builds the lats and biceps.
Règle la machine à levier au niveau de résistance souhaité.
Tiens-toi sur la plateforme pour les pieds et saisis les poignées en prise pronation, légèrement plus écartées que la largeur des épaules.
Suspends-toi, les bras complètement étendus, en gardant le corps droit.
Sollicite les muscles de ton dos et tire ton corps vers les poignées, en menant avec ta poitrine.
Continue à tirer jusqu'à ce que ton menton soit au-dessus des poignées.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement ton corps pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0573: On a machine, you extend your torso against a pad to work the lower back. Also brings in the glutes and hamstrings.
Règle la machine pour l'adapter à ta taille et à ton amplitude de mouvement.
Assieds-toi sur la machine, le dos contre le coussinet et les pieds bien calés.
Place tes mains sur les poignées ou les barres de prise.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et penche-toi lentement en avant, en laissant ton dos s'arrondir légèrement.
Marque une pause en position basse, en ressentant un étirement dans le bas de ton dos.
En utilisant les muscles de ton dos, relève lentement ton torse vers la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0574: A lever machine version of the bent over row. You pull the handles toward your torso to train the back and lats.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules et les genoux légèrement fléchis.
Tiens la barre en prise pronation, les mains un peu plus écartées que la largeur des épaules.
Penche-toi vers l'avant au niveau des hanches en gardant ton dos droit et ta poitrine haute.
Tire la barre vers le bas de ta poitrine, en contractant tes omoplates.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement la barre pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0575: Seated at a lever machine, you curl the handles up with an underhand grip. Isolates the biceps with a smooth path.
Règle la hauteur du siège et installe-toi sur la machine, le dos contre le coussin.
Saisis les poignées avec une prise en supination, les paumes tournées vers le haut, et garde les coudes près de tes flancs.
Expire et remonte les poignées vers le haut, en contractant tes biceps.
Marque une pause en haut du mouvement, en contractant tes biceps.
Inspire et abaisse lentement les poignées jusqu'à la position de départ, en tendant complètement les bras.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0576: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
Règle la hauteur du siège et installe-toi sur la machine, le dos bien à plat contre le coussin.
Saisis les poignées avec une prise en pronation et place tes coudes à un angle de 90 degrés.
Pousse les poignées vers l'avant jusqu'à ce que tes bras soient complètement tendus, en expirant pendant le mouvement.
Marque une brève pause à la fin du mouvement, puis reviens lentement à la position de départ en inspirant.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og0577: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
Règle la hauteur du siège et installe-toi sur la machine, le dos bien à plat contre le coussin.
Saisis les poignées avec une prise en pronation et place tes coudes à un angle de 90 degrés.
Pousse les poignées vers l'avant jusqu'à ce que tes bras soient complètement tendus, en expirant pendant le mouvement.
Marque une brève pause à la fin du mouvement, puis reviens lentement à la position de départ en inspirant.

og1183: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.

og1184: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.

Pull your chest to the bar.
og1186: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.

og1187: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.

Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.

og11878: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.

Lift as high as you can without swinging.
og11879: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.

og1188: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.

og11880: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.

og1189: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.

og1190: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.

og1191: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.

og1193: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.

og1194: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.

Pull the handles toward your torso.
og1195: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.

og11954: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.

Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
og1196: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.

og1440: A plank where you lift one arm at a time, training core stability and anti-rotation strength.

Lean slightly forward and lock your shoulders down.
Hold the position with your body still.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

og1443: Holding dumbbells out to the sides in a lying Maltese position. It is an advanced hold for the shoulders and chest.

Lift your arms out to the sides at about hip level.
Keep your arms straight and your body tight.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.

og1444: Holding a dumbbell over your chest with bent arms in a pullover position. It keeps the chest and lats under tension.

Lower it behind your head with your elbows bent.
Stop where you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Hold the position with your core tight.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lift it back up.
og1445: Holding the bottom of a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells. It loads the hamstrings in their stretched position.
Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold the position with a flat back.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then stand up.
og1446: Holding the bottom of a Zercher squat with the bar in your elbows. It challenges the legs and core.
Place the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then stand up.
og1447: A calf stretch on a plate-loaded lever machine, using the platform to push the heel down and lengthen the lower leg.

Let the heel sink down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
og1448: Hold a barbell overhead behind you while lying on a bench. It builds lat and chest control in the stretched position.

Lower the bar back over your head until you feel a deep stretch in your lats.

Return the bar over your chest with control and set it down safely.
og1449: A static hold at the bottom of an incline flye. It teaches chest tension and builds control in the stretched position.

Saisis les poignées avec une prise en pronation et place tes mains légèrement plus écartées que la largeur des épaules.
Pousse les poignées vers l'avant et loin de ton corps jusqu'à ce que tes bras soient complètement tendus, mais sans verrouiller tes coudes.
Marque une pause en position complètement étendue, puis fléchis lentement tes coudes et abaisse les poignées vers ta poitrine.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1480: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.
Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
og1481: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.
Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.
og1482: A gentle yoga backbend that opens the chest and stretches the front of the abs while strengthening the back.
Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Press the tops of your feet into the floor.
Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
og1483: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.
Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.
og1484: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.
og1485: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.
Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
og1486: A push-up on handles that lets you go a little deeper and keeps the wrists neutral. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
og1487: An inverted yoga pose balanced on the shoulders. It builds shoulder and core control and stretches the neck-side muscles.
Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands.
Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades.
Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders.
Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
og1488: A simple stretch that opens the front of the shoulders and chest by clasping the hands behind you.
Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
og1489: A squat where your knees travel far forward as you lean back. It isolates the quads with only your body weight.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules et les orteils légèrement tournés vers l'extérieur.
Tiens-toi à un objet stable pour l'équilibre si nécessaire.
Abaisse lentement ton corps en fléchissant les genoux et en te penchant en arrière, en gardant ton torse droit.
Continue à descendre jusqu'à ce que tes cuisses soient parallèles au sol ou aussi loin que tu peux confortablement aller.
Marque une pause, puis pousse sur tes talons pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1490: A calf raise with your heels hanging off a stair step for extra range. It trains the calves through a deep stretch.
Tiens-toi sur le bord d'une marche ou d'une plateforme solide, les talons dans le vide et les orteils sur la marche.
Tiens-toi à une rampe ou à un mur pour l'équilibre si nécessaire.
Lève lentement les talons le plus haut possible, en reportant le poids de ton corps sur la pointe des pieds.
Marque une pause en haut, puis abaisse lentement tes talons pour revenir à la position de départ.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1491: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.
Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
og1492: A stretch for the back of the upper arm, taken with the elbow bent overhead.
Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
og1493: A deep yoga backbend with hands and feet on the floor and the body arched upward. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.
Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel.
Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.
og1494: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.
Assieds-toi au sol, les jambes tendues devant toi.
Fléchis tes genoux et joins les plantes de tes pieds en laissant tes genoux tomber sur les côtés.
Tiens tes chevilles ou tes pieds avec tes mains.
Assieds-toi bien droit et allonge ta colonne vertébrale.
Appuie doucement tes genoux vers le sol, en sentant un étirement dans l'intérieur de tes cuisses.
Maintiens cette position pendant quelques respirations.
Pour relâcher, ramène lentement tes genoux vers le haut et tends tes jambes.
og1495: An oblique crunch where you curl up and to the side, version 2. It trains the side abs.
Allonge-toi sur le dos, les genoux fléchis et les pieds à plat au sol.
Place tes mains derrière ta tête ou croise-les sur ta poitrine.
Gaine tes abdominaux et décolle tes omoplates du sol, en faisant pivoter ton torse d'un côté.
Marque une pause, puis abaisse tes omoplates jusqu'à la position de départ.
Continue à alterner les côtés pour le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1496: Swinging a sledgehammer down onto a tire in a controlled arc. It trains the abs and obliques and also the shoulders and grip.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules et tiens la masse à deux mains.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et garde ton dos droit.
Abats le marteau vers le sol, en utilisant la force de ta sangle abdominale et du haut du corps.
En abaissant le marteau, pivote tes hanches et transfère la force au marteau.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1497: A bench press with bands that lighten the load at the bottom and add heavier tension near the top. It builds pressing strength.
Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change.
Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.
og1498: A decline sit-up with a band adding resistance. It trains the abs through a long range.
Anchor a band behind you and hold the other end at your chest.
Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Curl your torso up toward your knees, keeping tension on the band.
Pause at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down slowly under control.
og1499: A band-resisted overhead press from behind the neck. It trains the shoulders and triceps with rising tension.
Stand on the band and hold the ends at the back of your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your head forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level.
Only use this variation if your shoulders move comfortably in that position.
og1500: An upright row where the band is held under both feet. It builds the shoulders and upper traps.
Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading.
Pause briefly without shrugging too high.
og1501: A side plank with a rowing motion against a band held by a partner. It trains the lats and trunk stability.
Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you.
Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted.
Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Return slowly without letting your hips drop.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
og1502: A band version of the triceps pushdown that isolates the back of the arm.
Anchor the band high and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.
og1503: A simple band move pulling the arms apart in front of you. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders and helps posture.
Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
og1504: A lying triceps extension using a band for resistance. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
Anchor the band behind your head and lie on your back holding the ends.
Start with your arms straight above your chest.
Bend only your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up against the band.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.
og1505: A calf raise using a band for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
Secure the band under your feet or around your shoulders as set up.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower slowly until your heels are back on the floor.
og1506: A close-grip curl on an EZ bar with a band adding tension near the top. It targets the biceps.
Stand on the band and hold the EZ bar with a close grip, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
og1507: A standing hip flexion with a band around the foot or leg. It trains the hip flexors and quads.
Attach a band to a low anchor and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the knee forward and up toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
og1508: A band lateral raise that builds the sides of the shoulders.
Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your sides.
og1509: A barbell squat to a bench with chains adding load as you stand. It builds leg and hip strength and teaches consistent depth.
Set a bench behind you and load the bar with chains.
Place the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand, feeling the chains add weight.
og1510: A reverse lunge where the back leg steps behind and across the line of the front leg. It trains glutes, thighs and balance.
Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.
og1511: A stretch for the back of the thigh. You reach toward your toes with a long spine and feel the hamstrings lengthen.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules.
Avance le pied droit et transfère ton poids sur la jambe droite.
En gardant le dos droit, penche-toi lentement vers l'avant au niveau des hanches, en tendant les deux mains vers ton pied droit.
Maintiens l'étirement pendant 20 à 30 secondes, puis reviens à la position de départ.
og1512: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
Commence à quatre pattes, les mains directement sous les épaules et les genoux directement sous les hanches.
Étends une jambe droit vers l'arrière, en gardant ton genou fléchi et ton pied en flexion.
Abaisse lentement tes hanches vers le sol, en ressentant un étirement dans tes quadriceps.
Maintiens cette position pendant 20 à 30 secondes.
Change de jambe et répète l'étirement de l'autre côté.
og1513: A hip hinge with a band across your shoulders. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders.
Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
og1514: A short-range squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. It lets you handle heavier loads and builds leg strength.
Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your knees and hips a short way, about a quarter of the full depth.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
og1515: A deadlift performed with a clean-style setup and path. It trains the pulling position used in the clean.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended.
Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.
og1516: A clean started from blocks at about knee height. It trains the explosive pull and the catch without the first pull from the floor.
Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a full squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1517: The explosive pull of a clean, finished with a shrug and without the catch. It builds power and bar speed.
Set up over the bar with a flat back and a grip just outside your knees.
Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug.
Let your elbows rise high, but do not catch the bar.
Lower the bar with control and reset.
og1518: A split squat with the back foot on a decline bench and a barbell on your back. It builds single-leg strength.
Place the bar on your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a decline bench.
Step the front foot out to set a stable stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
og1519: A good morning on the Smith machine starting from the pins. It builds the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it.
Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.
og1520: A clean that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive hip drive and the catch.
Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a grip just outside your legs and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1521: A hang clean started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
Hold the bar just below your knees with a flat back and your shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1522: A snatch that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive pull and catching the bar overhead.
Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a wide snatch grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1523: A hang snatch started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
Hold the bar just below your knees with a wide grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1524: A snatch drill where you dip, drive and drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds speed and overhead stability.
Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip and drive up explosively, pushing the bar off your shoulders.
Drop quickly into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms over your mid-foot.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
og1525: The dip and drive part of the jerk, practised with a barbell on the shoulders. It trains a vertical dip and strong leg drive.
Rack the bar on your front shoulders and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and your core tight.
Dip a short way by bending your knees straight down.
Drive up explosively through your whole foot.
Settle back to standing and reset.
og1526: A snatch lifted overhead with straight arms and no re-bend of the knees. It trains the upper pull and arm turnover.
Hold the bar at the hips with a wide grip, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull the bar up high with your elbows, turn it over and press to locked arms overhead without squatting.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1527: A deep, upright high-bar squat in the weightlifting style. It builds leg strength and mobility.
Place the bar high on your upper back and set your feet about shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit straight down as deep as you can with heels flat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
og1528: A clean caught above parallel, started from blocks. It builds explosive power.
Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull and catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1529: An explosive overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and punch the bar overhead.
Dip under slightly and catch it with locked arms.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders with control.
og1530: A snatch caught overhead above parallel. It builds explosive power and speed.
Hold the bar at your shins with a wide grip, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1531: A power snatch started from blocks. It trains the explosive pull and the overhead catch.
Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1532: A Romanian deadlift standing on a small platform for extra range. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
Stand on a low platform holding the bar at your thighs.
Keep your knees soft and your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower as far as you can with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
og1533: The full snatch, lifting the bar from the floor to overhead in one motion and catching it in a deep squat.
Grip the bar wide, with it over your mid-foot, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1534: A drill where you drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds overhead stability and speed.
Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip a short way and drive up.
Drop into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms and your chest up.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
og1535: A deadlift with a wide snatch grip. It strengthens the pulling position used in the snatch.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip.
Set your back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close.
Stand tall with your hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar with control along the same path.
og1536: A snatch started from blocks. It trains the pull and the deep overhead catch.
Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1537: A clean caught in a split stance instead of a squat. It trains the explosive pull and the catch.
Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Split your feet front and back and catch the bar on your front shoulders.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
og1538: An overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a split stance.
Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back and catch with locked arms.
Bring your feet back together and lower the bar with control.
og1539: A jump with a barbell on the back where you switch the front and back leg in the air. It builds leg power.
Rest a light bar on your upper back and take a split stance.
Jump explosively and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
Keep your torso upright and continue alternating.
og1540: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together in one fluid rep.
Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly forward and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lock out the press with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Keep your core braced the whole time and avoid arching your lower back.
og1541: Squat down with the bar hanging in front of you, then stand and pull it up to chest height. Works thighs, glutes and upper back in one move.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and squat down, letting the bar slide down to your knees.
Drive up through your heels to stand tall.
As you rise, pull the bar up close to your body until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar under control and go straight into the next squat.
og1542: A stiff-legged deadlift performed while standing on a bench, giving you extra range of motion. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and lower back.
Stand on a sturdy bench holding a barbell at thigh level, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees almost straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar toward your toes with a flat back as far as your hamstrings allow.
Pause briefly, then squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
Keep the bar close to your legs and stay in control throughout.
og1543: The classic stiff-legged deadlift, hinging at the hips with nearly straight knees. A great builder for hamstrings, glutes and the lower back.
Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your back flat and your chest proud the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
og1544: A stiff-legged deadlift with a wide stance that brings in the inner thighs and glutes. It also keeps the hamstrings under a deep stretch.
Take a wide stance, toes slightly out, with the barbell held in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs.
Squeeze your glutes to rise back to standing.
og1545: A squat with the bar held in the crooks of your elbows at full depth. It hits the quads, glutes and upper back.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules et les orteils légèrement tournés vers l'extérieur.
Tiens la barre au creux de tes coudes, tes mains agrippant la barre pour la stabilité.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et garde ta poitrine relevée pendant que tu abaisses tes hanches vers l'arrière et le bas en position de squat.
Garde les genoux alignés avec les orteils et le poids dans les talons.
Descends jusqu'à ce que tes cuisses soient parallèles au sol, ou aussi bas que tu peux confortablement aller.
Pousse sur tes talons pour te relever, en contractant tes fessiers en haut du mouvement.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1546: A squat with your back against a wall, which keeps your torso upright and takes pressure off the lower back. Good for building leg endurance.
Lean your back against a wall with your feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the planned number of reps.
og1547: Standing on one leg, you curl the other against a low cable. It isolates the hamstrings one side at a time.
Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine and hold on for balance, with the working leg slightly behind you.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
og1548: Using a chair for support, you extend one leg to stretch the thigh and hip. It loosens up the quads.
Assieds-toi au bord d'une chaise, le dos droit et les pieds à plat sur le sol.
Étends une jambe droit devant toi, en gardant ton talon au sol.
Penche-toi légèrement en avant, en sentant un étirement dans tes quadriceps.
Maintiens cette position pendant 20 à 30 secondes.
Change de jambe et répète l'étirement.
og1549: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.
og1550: A single-leg squat with the other foot resting on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells. It hammers the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand a step in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg.
Keep your front knee over your toes and your chest up.
Push through your front heel to stand, then switch legs after your reps.
og1551: A rear-foot-elevated lunge using a decline bench and dumbbells. The raised back foot shifts the load onto the front leg.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a decline bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front foot to rise, then switch legs after your reps.
og1552: An explosive squat jump holding light dumbbells at your sides. It builds power in the legs and gets the heart pumping.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
og1553: A side lunge combined with a biceps curl. It works the legs and arms together and also loosens the inner thighs.
Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a big step to the side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Curl both dumbbells up as you lower into the lunge.
Push off your bent leg to return to the middle while lowering the weights.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.
og1554: A jumping lunge where you switch legs in the air while holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a lunge position.
Lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Explode upward and swap your leg positions in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Keep your torso upright and move fluidly from rep to rep.
og1555: A simple squat holding a dumbbell in each hand. It is a solid all-round leg builder that is easy to load.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor or a bit lower.
Keep your chest up and your heels planted.
Press through your feet to stand back up.
og1556: A stiff-legged deadlift with dumbbells while standing on a bench for extra depth. It targets the hamstrings and lower back.
Stand on a sturdy bench holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells down your legs and below the bench level with a flat back.
Pause when you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
og1557: Lunges done on the move with dumbbells in your hands. A great move for leg strength, glutes and coordination.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push off your back foot and step through into a lunge with the other leg.
og1558: A wall squat made harder by holding dumbbells. It keeps your back supported while loading the legs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean your back against a wall.
Walk your feet forward so your knees stay over your ankles when you squat.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
og1559: You kneel with a stability ball for support and push the hips forward. It stretches the hip flexors at the front of the hip.
Place le ballon de stabilité au sol et agenouille-toi devant lui.
Place ton pied droit sur le ballon de stabilité, le genou fléchi à un angle de 90 degrés.
Étends ta jambe gauche derrière toi, en la gardant tendue.
Penche-toi en avant, en poussant tes hanches vers le ballon de stabilité, jusqu'à ce que tu sentes un étirement dans le fléchisseur de ta hanche droite.
Maintiens l'étirement pendant 20 à 30 secondes, puis change de côté et répète.
og1560: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
Assieds-toi sur le ballon de stabilité, les pieds à plat sur le sol et les genoux fléchis à un angle de 90 degrés.
Fais rouler lentement le ballon vers l'avant, en avançant les pieds jusqu'à ce que le haut de ton dos repose sur le ballon et que tes jambes soient tendues droit devant toi.
Place tes mains sur tes hanches pour te soutenir.
Gaine ta sangle abdominale et abaisse lentement le haut du corps vers le sol, en gardant le dos droit et la poitrine relevée.
Arrête-toi lorsque tu sens un étirement dans les ischio-jambiers, et maintiens la position pendant 20 à 30 secondes.
Reviens lentement à la position de départ en poussant sur tes talons et en utilisant tes ischio-jambiers pour te tirer vers le haut.
Répète le nombre de répétitions souhaité.
og1561: A gentle quad stretch using a stability ball for support. It opens up the front of the thigh.
Sit on the edge of a stability ball with your torso upright.
Hold on to something steady for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glutes, holding your ankle.
Keep your knees close together and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
og1562: A squat with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball keeps the movement smooth and supports your back.
Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet forward about a step and stand shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and let the ball roll down your back as you squat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.
og1563: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.
Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.
og1564: A deeper stretch for the hip flexors and quads, using a rope or strap to pull the foot toward you.
Tiens-toi debout bien droit, les pieds écartés à la largeur des épaules.
Tiens-toi à un objet stable pour te soutenir.
Fléchis ton genou droit et amène ton pied droit vers tes fessiers en saisissant la corde avec ta main droite.
Tire lentement ton pied droit vers tes fessiers, en ressentant un étirement dans ton quadriceps droit.
Relâche l'étirement et répète du côté gauche.
og1565: A clean that starts from a dead stop on the floor each rep, with no swing. It builds explosive hip drive and pulling power.
Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grab the handle.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the handle and catch the bell at your shoulder.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset before the next rep.
og1566: A squat while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm. It trains leg strength together with shoulder stability and core control.
Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock out your elbow.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and keep your ribs down.
Squat down with your chest up while keeping the bell stable over your shoulder.
Go as low as you can with good control.
Drive up through your heels, then switch arms after your reps.
og1567: A kettlebell clean where your palm stays open and you catch the bell on your forearm. It teaches a smooth hip-driven pull.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge down and grab the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to pull it up.
Keep your hand open and guide the bell to rest at your shoulder.
Lower it back with control and repeat, then switch sides.
og1568: A one-armed kettlebell swing driven by the hips. It builds the posterior chain and conditioning.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and hold a kettlebell with one hand.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to chest height.
Keep your arm relaxed and your back flat.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, then switch hands after your reps.
og1569: A single-leg hip hinge holding a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the bell toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return upright, then switch legs.
og1570: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.
og1571: A machine leg extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and helps even out strength between sides.
Sit on the machine and adjust the pad so it rests on your lower shin.
Set one foot under the pad and keep the other foot on the floor or footrest.
Extend your working leg until it is almost straight.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
og1572: A seated machine squat using one leg in a wide stance. It loads the quads, glutes and inner thighs with back support.
Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot wide on the platform and keep the other leg off the load.
Lower by bending your working knee as far as is comfortable.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.
og1573: A seated machine squat done on one leg. It lets you load each leg separately with good support.
Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot on the platform at about shoulder width.
Lower under control by bending your knee.
Keep your heel flat and your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.
og1574: A seated machine squat with a wide stance. It puts extra emphasis on the glutes and inner thighs.
Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Set both feet wide on the platform with toes slightly out.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.
og1575: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together. The narrow stance puts the focus on the quads.
Sit in the sled with your back flat against the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Lower the sled by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.
Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
og1576: Lying on your back with one leg raised, you draw it toward you to stretch the hamstring.
Allonge-toi sur le dos, les jambes tendues.
Plie un genou et amène-le vers ta poitrine en tenant ta cuisse ou ton tibia.
Tends la jambe autant que possible tout en la gardant surélevée.
og1577: A lying stretch that opens the front of the hip. Handy after long periods of sitting.
Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the knee relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
og1578: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.
Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.
og1579: A hack squat on the sled using one leg at a time. It isolates each quad and glute with solid back support.

Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off.
Release the safety and lower by bending your working knee.
Go as deep as you can with control.
Press up through your heel, then switch legs after your reps.
og1580: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
og1581: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.
og1582: Lying on your back, you hold your big toe with a rope and raise the leg straight. It stretches the hamstrings.

Lève lentement la jambe droite vers la poitrine, en gardant le genou tendu et le pied fléchi.

og1583: A hack squat done facing the pad on the sled. It puts more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
Face the pad of the hack squat sled with your chest against it and feet on the platform.
Hold the handles and release the safety.
Lower by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest pressed against the pad.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
og1584: A deep squat followed by a big vertical jump with your arms reaching up. It builds explosive leg power.
Squat down while swinging your arms back.
Explode upward and reach both arms overhead as you jump.
Extend your whole body like a rocket.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.
og1585: A lunge position stretch for the hips, thighs and hamstrings, often used by runners to loosen up.
Tiens-toi debout, les pieds écartés à la largeur des hanches.
Fais un pas en avant avec le pied droit, en gardant le pied gauche bien ancré.
Fléchis ton genou droit et abaisse ton corps en gardant ta jambe gauche tendue.
Place tes mains sur ta cuisse droite pour te soutenir.
Maintiens l'étirement pendant 20 à 30 secondes, puis change de côté et répète.
og1586: A seated hamstring curl on a machine with one leg at a time. It isolates each hamstring.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and adjust the leg pad above your heel.
Place one leg under the pad and rest the other foot on the footrest.
Curl your heel down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstring at the bottom.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
og1587: A seated sequence with legs wide that stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings. Move slowly with the breath.
Assieds-toi au sol, les jambes tendues et largement écartées.
Fléchis tes pieds et contracte tes quadriceps.
Place tes mains au sol derrière toi pour le soutien.
En gardant le dos droit, penche-toi vers l'avant à partir des hanches.

Maintiens cette position pendant quelques respirations.
Relâche lentement l'étirement et reviens à la position de départ.

og1588: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.
Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.
og1589: A hopping drill where you flick one heel up to your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted.
Hop lightly on your standing foot.
Kick your free heel toward your glutes each hop.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
og1590: A lying hamstring curl on a machine using one leg at a time. It helps balance strength between legs.
Lie face down on the machine and place one leg under the pad above your heel.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
og1591: An explosive single-leg push off the floor or a step. It builds leg drive useful for running and jumping.
Stand in front of a low step with one foot planted on it.
Lean slightly forward and keep your core tight.
Push off the step explosively with that leg and drive your opposite knee up.
Land softly on the same foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
og1592: A bounding jump from one leg to the other leg. It develops power and single-leg control.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap forward as far as you can.
Land on the opposite leg and absorb the impact with a soft knee.
Hold the landing for a moment to stay balanced.
Repeat, alternating legs or staying on one side.
og1593: A squat down to a seat and back up. The chair gives you a depth target and builds confidence.
Stand in front of a chair or bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower yourself toward the seat.
Lightly touch the seat without relaxing completely.
Keep your chest up and your knees over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.
og1594: A front-loaded squat on the smith machine with your arms stretched straight in front. It strongly challenges the quads and upper back posture.
Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your front shoulders.
Extend your arms straight forward, like a zombie, to keep the bar in place.
Unrack the bar and step into a stable stance.
Squat down with your chest up and your torso upright.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.
og1595: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.
Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.
og1596: A smith machine squat down to a bench behind you. The bench gives a consistent depth target.
Place a bench behind you under the smith bar.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.
og1597: A stiff-legged deadlift using the smith machine bar. The fixed path lets you focus on feeling the hamstrings work.

Unrack it and keep your knees nearly straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
og1598: A squat holding the bar in the crooks of your elbows on the smith machine. It trains the legs while taxing the core and upper back.
Set the bar at waist height and hook your elbows under it with your arms crossed.
Unrack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest up and the bar close to your body.
Go until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.
og1599: Standing with a strap around your foot, you pull your toes toward you to stretch the hamstring and calf.
