Place the roller under the upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Slide the roller forward as you rotate your chest open.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5389: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes and hip. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Place the roller under the glutes and hip and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean toward the crossed leg and roll gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5390: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Sit on the roller with your hands behind you.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly back and forth under your glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5391: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Lie on your back with the roller under one glute.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Let the knees drop to one side and twist gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5392: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the hamstrings and glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Sit with the roller under your thighs and hands behind you.
Place the roller under the hamstrings and glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll from the knee toward the glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5393: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer thigh. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
Place the roller under the outer thigh and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll from the hip down to above the knee.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5394: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Kneel on all fours with the roller under your shins.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5395: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Rest one shin on the roller, supporting yourself on your hands.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5396: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Lie on your side with the roller under your outer lower leg.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5397: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Lie on your side with the roller under the outer lower leg, other foot behind for support.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5398: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the sole of the foot. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
Stand or sit with the roller under one foot.
Place the roller under the sole of the foot and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll the sole from heel to toes, then switch feet.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
og5399: Holding a stick overhead or in front while you brace your midsection. Builds trunk stability and teaches you to keep the ribs down.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.
og5400: A standing stretch that uses a stick to pull the arm overhead and open up the side of your back. Good for tight lats and overhead mobility.
Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.
og5401: Stretches the front of your shoulders and chest using a stick for leverage. Helps with posture and overhead reach.
Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
og5402: A lunge combined with a stick held overhead. Opens the hip flexors of the back leg and the shoulders at the same time.
Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.
og5403: A gentle standing rotation with a stick across your shoulders. Loosens the mid back and trunk.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.
og5404: Swinging a stick from front to back in a wide arc to open up the shoulders. A classic warm-up for shoulder mobility.
Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.
og5405: A standing side bend with a stick raised overhead. Lengthens the side of your trunk and the lats.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your chest open.
Bend slowly to one side without leaning forward.
Return to center and bend to the other side.
og5406: Combines a side bend with a forward fold while holding a stick overhead. Stretches the side body, lower back and hamstrings.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
og5407: A deep wide-stance squat while holding a stick overhead. Opens the inner thighs and hips and challenges shoulder mobility.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds.
Press up through your feet to stand.
og5408: A lunge with a trunk twist while holding a stick. Stretches the hip flexors and loosens the spine.
Hold the stick across your chest or in front with both hands and step into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Twist your torso over the front leg.
Untwist, step back and switch legs.
og5445: Drawing your belly in as far as you can while standing. Trains the deep abdominal muscles that keep your trunk tight.
Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.
og5447: A plate-loaded seated row with an overhand grip. Targets the upper back and lats.
Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms extend.
og5448: A short seated row focusing on pulling your shoulder blades together. Isolates the mid back.
Sit in the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles overhand with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows much.
Let your shoulder blades spread slowly.
og5449: Curl the dumbbells while dragging them up along your body, with elbows moving back. Keeps tension on the biceps.
Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping them close to your torso.
Let your elbows travel slightly back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
og5450: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps. Gives your biceps a burn.
Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
og5451: A glute bridge with a barbell across your hips and a knees-forward setup. Keeps tension on the glutes through the whole rep.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
og5458: Raise one dumbbell diagonally across your body. Works the chest and front shoulder.
Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
og5460: A push-up pushed fast enough for your hands to leave the floor. Builds upper-body power.
Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.
og5466: A plank where you lift an arm and the opposite leg. Challenges your core stability.
Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
og5469: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps using dumbbells.
Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
og5470: Standing cable kickback angled out to the side that targets the upper glutes (gluteus medius) and hip stability.
Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
og5471: Hip-extension variation on a back extension bench where you keep a relaxed, rounded upper back to bias the glutes and hamstrings.
Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.
og5472: Floor ab exercise where you lift bent knees toward your chest, working the lower abs with less lever length than straight legs.
Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
og5473: Pull-up with palms facing each other at shoulder width, a joint-friendly grip that builds the lats and arms.
Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
og5474: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.
og5476: A hip thrust with one foot set slightly ahead of the other. Shifts more load to one side and challenges hip stability.
Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.
og5477: Hanging-style leg raise performed supported on parallel bars, taking the legs high to challenge the lower abs.
Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
og5478: Explosive lunge-and-drive-knee movement off a bosu ball that trains leg power and balance.
Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
og5479: Pull-up using a narrow overhand grip to emphasise the lower lats and arms.
Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.
og5480: A seated stretch where you pull the foot toward you with a band. Lengthens the calf and the back of the leg.
Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop the band around the ball of that foot.
Hold the band ends with both hands and sit tall.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your knee straight.
og5481: Gentle seated mobility drill sliding the foot along the floor to warm up the ankle and calf.
Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
og5482: Low-impact hopping on one leg to build ankle stiffness, balance and leg power.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
og5483: Seated calf raise with weight on your thighs that targets the soleus muscle under the calf.
Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
og5484: One-leg seated calf raise with weight on the knee, working the soleus with extra focus on each side.
Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
og5496: Goblet squat with your heels raised on a plate or wedge so the knees travel forward and the quads work harder.
Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
og5497: Plank variation where you pass a dumbbell under your body from hand to hand, challenging core stability.
Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
og5498: Marching in place while holding a plate overhead, building leg strength, balance and shoulder stability.
Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.
og5513: Bench dip with your feet on a stability ball for extra instability, hammering the triceps.
Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.
og5514: Crunch with legs raised and a rotation at the top that hits the abs and obliques.
Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.
og5515: Sit-up on a decline bench that increases the range and load on the abs.
Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
og5516: Plate-loaded hack squat machine that lets you load the quads and glutes with back support.
Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Do not lock your knees hard at the top.
og5517: A bodyweight row hanging under a bar with an underhand grip. Builds the back and biceps.
Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
og5518: One-arm cable row from a kneeling position, leaning forward to give a long pull for the lats and mid back.
Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
og5522: Pull-up on gymnastic rings, which move freely and demand extra stability from the back and arms.
Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
og5524: One-arm face pull on a cable that trains the rear delts and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.
og5526: Hooping around your waist with a hula hoop for light cardio and core engagement.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.
og5527: Machine rear-delt fly where you lean forward and sweep your arms back.
Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
og5528: Overhead triceps extension on crossed cables for a strong stretch and squeeze.
Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
og5529: Full-depth squat followed by an overhead press, a thruster-style move that works legs and shoulders together.
Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.
og5537: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.
Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.
og5553: Seated cable row set up to emphasise the lats with a pull toward the hips.
Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
og5554: A glute bridge with a dumbbell on your hips and the knees kept slightly forward. Keeps tension on the glutes.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
og5555: Hip-hinge pattern with no load that warms up the hamstrings and lower back.
Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
og5556: Push-up focusing on the slow lowering phase to build strength for full reps.
Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.
og5557: Doorway stretch for the chest and front of the shoulders.
Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
og5576: Plate-loaded machine press on an incline, one arm at a time, for upper chest.
Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handle up and forward until the arm is nearly straight.
og5577: Sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor to build strength out of the bottom.
Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
og5579: Seated wrist curl with an EZ bar to build the forearm flexors.
Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
og5581: Kneeling one-arm lat pulldown for a stretch and strong contraction on each side.
Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
og5582: Lunge stepping backward from a raised surface, which increases the range of motion.
Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
og5583: A machine crunch on a curved track that lets you curl your trunk and knees together. Builds the abs under load.
Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
og5598: Combo of an inchworm walk-out followed by mountain climbers for a full-body workout.
Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
og5606: Prone swing with dumbbells to target the rear delts.
Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
og5607: Face pull using a band to train the rear delts and upper back.
Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
og5608: Standing chest press against a band anchored behind you.
Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
og5609: Cable face pull to build the rear delts and strengthen the upper back.
Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
og5623: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.
og5628: Squat with a landmine bar held at your chest, mimicking a hack squat.
Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
og5630: Squat with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
og5631: Lateral raise with elbows bent to isolate the side delts.
Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
og5632: Upright row with a shoulder-width grip.
Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
og5633: Back squat with a narrow stance for more quad focus.
Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
og5634: Narrow stance squat holding dumbbells to build the quads.
Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Squat down with your chest up.
og5635: Bent-arm lateral raise that shifts load onto the side delts.
Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
og5636: Kneeling one-arm landmine press for shoulder strength with an angled path.
Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
og5637: Push-up with hands elevated on a bench, an easier version of the push-up.
Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
og5649: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.
Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
og5656: Face pull with a rope attachment to hit the rear delts.
Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
og5657: Side bend using a cable for the obliques.
Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
og5658: Seated rope face pull for the rear delts.
Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Pull the rope toward your face.
og5659: Squat starting from the bottom position, pausing each rep to build strength.
Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Drive up from a dead stop.
og5660: Bench press from pins in the rack, starting from a dead stop at the chest.
Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Lower to the pins and pause.
og5661: Chest-supported dumbbell row to reduce lower back stress.
Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
og5662: Explosive shrug with a barbell, using a hip drive to build the traps.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
og5663: Deadlift with the bar held behind you, a quad-friendly lift.
Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
og5664: Seated leg extension using a cable for the quads.
Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
og5665: Hinge forward and pull two dumbbells toward your face with elbows high. It works the rear delts and upper back and helps shoulder posture.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.
og5666: An explosive pull that drives dumbbells up to chest height using the legs and hips. It builds the shoulders and traps and trains power.

Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.
og5911: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
og5912: Sumo deadlift with chains added to the bar for extra resistance near lockout, hitting the glutes, thighs and back.
Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.
og5913: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.
Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.
og5914: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
og5915: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.
Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.
og5916: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.
Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.
og5917: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.
Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
og5921: A preacher curl with a neutral hammer grip that targets the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.
og5938: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.
Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.
og5943: A one-arm cable front raise with a palm-in grip, giving steady tension to the front of the shoulder.
Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
og5944: A one-arm dumbbell front raise using a hammer grip, targeting the front deltoid with less wrist strain.
Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.
og5963: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.
Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.
og5965: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.
Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.
og5966: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.
og5967: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.
Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
og5968: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
og5969: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.
Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
og5970: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.
Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.
og5971: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.
Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
og5972: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.
Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.
og5973: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.
Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.
og5974: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.
Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
og5975: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
og5976: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.
og5977: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.
Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.
og5978: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.
Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.
og5979: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.
Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Stay low through turns and repeat.
og5980: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.
Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.
og5981: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.
Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.
og5982: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.
Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.
og5983: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.
og5984: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.
Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
og5985: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.
Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
og5986: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.
Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.
og5988: A light deadlift holding a bottle in each hand. A good way to learn the hip hinge.
Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
og5989: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.
Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.
og5990: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.
Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.
og5991: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.
Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.
og5997: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.
og5998: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
og6000: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.
og6001: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.
Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
og6002: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
og6005: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.
og6006: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
og6007: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
og6008: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
og6010: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.
og6011: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
og6013: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
og6014: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
og6016: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
og6017: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.
Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.
og6019: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
og6024: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Keep your hips on the floor.
og6025: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
og6026: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
og6027: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.
og6032: A seated cable row with a V handle and a neutral grip. It builds the mid back and lats.
Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.
og6033: A seated or lying tuck that draws knees and chest together to train the abs.
Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
og6034: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.
Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.
og6035: A cable row with a parallel bar that targets the rear delts and upper back.
Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
og6036: A straight-arm pulldown variation that isolates the lats by keeping the elbows nearly straight.
Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
og6038: A kick-back using the Smith machine bar under the foot, to target the glutes.
Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.
og6041: A hip hinge holding a weighted bottle in each hand. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with light load.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.
og6042: A one-legged hip hinge holding weighted bottles. It works the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance.
Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
og6043: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.
Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.
og6044: A squat holding weighted bottles at shoulder height. It works the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.
Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
og6045: A wide-stance squat holding a weighted bottle between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.
og6046: A stationary lunge holding bottles at your sides. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
og6047: A walking-style lunge stepping forward with bottles in your hands. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
og6048: A lunge stepping backward while holding bottles. It is easy on the knees and trains the glutes and quads.
Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.
og6049: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
og6050: A hip bridge with a weighted bottle resting on your hips. It isolates the glutes with light load.
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
og6051: A squat from a kneeling position holding a bottle. It trains the glutes and hips without loading your feet.
Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
og6052: A crunch with a bottle held overhead. The extra lever length makes your abs work harder.
Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.
og6053: A crunch that draws knees and chest together while holding a bottle. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
og6054: A standing side bend with a bottle in one hand. It strengthens the obliques.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
og6055: A seated rotation holding a bottle. It works the obliques and deep core.
Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.
og6056: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
og6057: A floor or bench press with a bottle in each hand. It builds the chest and triceps with light load.
Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
og6058: A standing press with a bottle squeezed between your palms. It keeps constant tension on the chest.
Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
og6059: A bent-over row with a bottle in each hand. It trains the mid back and lats.
Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
og6060: A lying pullover with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.
og6061: A bent-over fly with bottles that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
og6063: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps.
Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
og6064: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
og6065: A one-arm triceps kickback holding a bottle. It isolates the back of the arm.
Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
og6066: A triceps kickback done with both arms together using two bottles.
Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
og6067: An overhead extension with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and strengthens the triceps.
Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
og6068: Alternating curls with a bottle in each hand. It builds the biceps and keeps the pace easy.
Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
og6069: Alternating curls with palms facing in. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
og6070: A curl with an overhand grip holding bottles. It trains the forearms and brachialis.
Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
og6071: A vertical pull with bottles toward your chest. It works the shoulders and traps.
Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.
og6072: A high row pulling bottles up toward your armpits. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
og6073: A front raise with bottles for the front of the shoulders.
Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
og6074: A side raise with bottles that builds the shoulder caps.
Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
og6075: Alternating front raises with a bottle in each hand. It works the front delts.
Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
og6076: An overhead press with a bottle in each hand. It builds shoulders and triceps.
Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Do not arch your lower back.
og6077: A circular movement of a bottle around your head. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.
og6092: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.
Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.
og6094: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.
og6097: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
og6098: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
